## Walk through the project

This site documents the urban stormwater design for an undeveloped 233-acre parcel on the eastern edge of Erie, Colorado. The work pairs a hydrologic frequency analysis built in R with a SWMM model of the developed condition to size a constructed wetland park for full-spectrum detention.

-   [**Site**](site.qmd) — vicinity, land use, soils, constraints
-   [**Precipitation**](precipitation.qmd) — GEV fit, NOAA Atlas 14 comparison
-   [**Design storms**](design-storms.qmd) — 2- through 100-yr hyetographs
-   [**Hydrographs**](hydrographs.qmd) — CUHP and SWMM routing
-   [**Results**](results.qmd) — peak reductions, WQCV, TSS load
-   [**About**](about.qmd) — course, stack, references
